#!/usr/bin/env python3
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time
import traceback
import uuid

ROOT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('aws_cli', ROOT / 'scripts/aws/aws_cli.py')
aws_cli = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(aws_cli)
SOURCE, TARGET = 'us-west-2', 'us-east-2'
PREFIX = 'stackd-sm-repl-auth-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
FIXTURE = ROOT / 'testdata/aws/secretsmanager/replication_authority.json'
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL')}
ENV.update(AWS_REGION=SOURCE, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=SOURCE, AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='2', AWS_PAGER='')
identity = aws_cli.call('sts', 'get-caller-identity', {}, ENV)
ACCOUNT = identity['Account']
fixture = {'account': ACCOUNT, 'region': SOURCE, 'secondary_region': TARGET, 'prefix': PREFIX, 'observations': [], 'cleanup': [], 'notes': [], 'source': {'probe_python': Path(__file__).read_text()}, 'probe_completed': False}
if FIXTURE.exists():
    fixture['previous_capture'] = json.loads(FIXTURE.read_text())
secrets = []
role = False
cleanup = False

def save():
    FIXTURE.write_text(json.dumps(fixture, indent=2) + '\n')

def observe(label, operation, params, region=SOURCE, service='secretsmanager', credentials=None):
    env = dict(ENV, AWS_REGION=region, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=region)
    if credentials:
        env.update(credentials)
    start = int(time.time()*1000)
    result = aws_cli.observe(service, operation, params, env)
    entry = {'label': label, 'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'region': region, 'input': params, 'request_started_ms': start, 'request_finished_ms': int(time.time()*1000), 'result': result}
    fixture['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append(entry)
    save()
    print(label, result['code'], flush=True)
    return result

def success(label, operation, params, region=SOURCE, service='secretsmanager', credentials=None):
    result = observe(label, operation, params, region, service, credentials)
    if result['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(label + ': ' + result['code'])
    return result['output']

def create(label, name, value, region=SOURCE):
    secrets.append((region, name))
    return success(label, 'create-secret', {'Name': name, 'SecretString': value, 'Description': 'native replication authority probe', 'Tags': [{'Key': 'probe', 'Value': 'initial'}]}, region)['ARN']

def settle(label, arn, expected=None):
    last = None
    for n in range(24):
        last = success(label + '-' + str(n+1), 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
        status = last.get('ReplicationStatus', [])
        if status and all(x['Status'] != 'InProgress' for x in status):
            if expected is None or all(x['Status'] == expected for x in status):
                return last
        time.sleep(2)
    return last

def role_credentials(deny):
    policy = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Action': '*', 'Resource': '*'}, {'Effect': 'Deny', 'Action': deny[0], 'Resource': '*', 'Condition': {'StringEquals': {'aws:RequestedRegion': deny[1]}}}]}
    for attempt in range(20):
        result = aws_cli.observe('sts', 'assume-role', {'RoleArn': 'arn:aws:iam::' + ACCOUNT + ':role/' + PREFIX, 'RoleSessionName': 'replication-probe', 'Policy': json.dumps(policy), 'DurationSeconds': 900}, ENV)
        if result['code'] == 'Success':
            c = result['output']['Credentials']
            fixture['notes'].append({'topic': 'Session policy', 'policy': policy, 'credential_values_retained': False})
            save()
            return {'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID': c['AccessKeyId'], 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY': c['SecretAccessKey'], 'AWS_SESSION_TOKEN': c['SessionToken']}
        time.sleep(2)
    raise RuntimeError('owned probe role could not be assumed: ' + result['code'])

try:
    name = PREFIX + '-metadata'
    primary = create('create-primary', name, 'synthetic-first')
    first = success('read-initial-version', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': primary})['VersionId']
    second = success('put-second', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': primary, 'SecretString': 'synthetic-second'})['VersionId']
    custom = success('put-custom', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': primary, 'SecretString': 'synthetic-custom', 'VersionStages': ['CUSTOM']})['VersionId']
    collision = create('create-destination-collision', name, 'synthetic-independent', TARGET)
    success('replicate-collision', 'replicate-secret-to-regions', {'SecretId': primary, 'AddReplicaRegions': [{'Region': TARGET}]})
    settle('collision-status', primary)
    success('force-overwrite-collision', 'replicate-secret-to-regions', {'SecretId': primary, 'AddReplicaRegions': [{'Region': TARGET}], 'ForceOverwriteReplicaSecret': True})
    settle('forced-status', primary, 'InSync')
    target = primary.replace(':' + SOURCE + ':', ':' + TARGET + ':')
    success('describe-forced-target', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': target}, TARGET)
    observe('old-destination-arn', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': collision}, TARGET)
    success('replica-versions', 'list-secret-version-ids', {'SecretId': target, 'IncludeDeprecated': True}, TARGET)
    success('read-custom-replica', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': target, 'VersionId': custom}, TARGET)
    observe('tag-replica-local', 'tag-resource', {'SecretId': target, 'Tags': [{'Key': 'local', 'Value': 'replica-only'}]}, TARGET)
    success('update-primary-description', 'update-secret', {'SecretId': primary, 'Description': 'changed metadata without changing values'})
    policy = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'AWS': identity['Arn']}, 'Action': 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue', 'Resource': '*'}]}
    success('primary-resource-policy', 'put-resource-policy', {'SecretId': primary, 'ResourcePolicy': json.dumps(policy)})
    success('move-custom-stage', 'update-secret-version-stage', {'SecretId': primary, 'VersionStage': 'CUSTOM', 'MoveToVersionId': first, 'RemoveFromVersionId': custom})
    time.sleep(5)
    success('replica-after-metadata', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': target}, TARGET)
    success('replica-resource-policy', 'get-resource-policy', {'SecretId': target}, TARGET)
    success('read-relabeled-replica', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': target, 'VersionStage': 'CUSTOM'}, TARGET)
    observe('replicate-existing-region', 'replicate-secret-to-regions', {'SecretId': primary, 'AddReplicaRegions': [{'Region': TARGET}]})
    observe('replicate-primary-region', 'replicate-secret-to-regions', {'SecretId': primary, 'AddReplicaRegions': [{'Region': SOURCE}]})
    observe('replicate-duplicate-region', 'replicate-secret-to-regions', {'SecretId': primary, 'AddReplicaRegions': [{'Region': TARGET}, {'Region': TARGET}]})
    trust = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'AWS': identity['Arn']}, 'Action': 'sts:AssumeRole'}]}
    success('create-owned-probe-role', 'create-role', {'RoleName': PREFIX, 'AssumeRolePolicyDocument': json.dumps(trust)}, service='iam')
    role = True
    arn_pattern = 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:' + ACCOUNT + ':secret:' + PREFIX + '*'
    role_policy = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Action': 'secretsmanager:*', 'Resource': arn_pattern}, {'Effect': 'Allow', 'Action': ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey', 'kms:Encrypt'], 'Resource': '*', 'Condition': {'StringLike': {'kms:EncryptionContext:SecretARN': arn_pattern}}}]}
    success('set-owned-probe-role-policy', 'put-role-policy', {'RoleName': PREFIX, 'PolicyName': 'owned-probe-only', 'PolicyDocument': json.dumps(role_policy)}, service='iam')
    source_denied = role_credentials((['kms:Decrypt'], SOURCE))
    target_denied = role_credentials((['kms:GenerateDataKey', 'kms:Encrypt'], TARGET))
    authority_name = PREFIX + '-authority'
    authority = create('create-authority-primary', authority_name, 'synthetic-authority-initial')
    secrets.append((TARGET, authority_name))
    observe('replicate-source-decrypt-denied', 'replicate-secret-to-regions', {'SecretId': authority, 'AddReplicaRegions': [{'Region': TARGET}]}, credentials=source_denied)
    settle('source-denied-status', authority)
    observe('replicate-destination-encryption-denied', 'replicate-secret-to-regions', {'SecretId': authority, 'AddReplicaRegions': [{'Region': TARGET}], 'ForceOverwriteReplicaSecret': True}, credentials=target_denied)
    settle('destination-denied-status', authority)
    success('retry-authorized-replication', 'replicate-secret-to-regions', {'SecretId': authority, 'AddReplicaRegions': [{'Region': TARGET}], 'ForceOverwriteReplicaSecret': True})
    settle('authorized-status', authority, 'InSync')
    observe('fresh-put-source-decrypt-denied', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': authority, 'SecretString': 'synthetic-denied-source-decrypt'}, credentials=source_denied)
    time.sleep(5)
    authority_target = authority.replace(':' + SOURCE + ':', ':' + TARGET + ':')
    observe('read-after-source-denied-put', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': authority_target}, TARGET)
    observe('fresh-put-destination-encryption-denied', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': authority, 'SecretString': 'synthetic-denied-destination-encryption'}, credentials=target_denied)
    time.sleep(5)
    success('status-after-destination-denied-put', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': authority})
    observe('read-after-destination-denied-put', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': authority_target}, TARGET)
    fixture['probe_completed'] = True
except Exception:
    fixture['failure'] = traceback.format_exc()
    print(fixture['failure'], flush=True)
finally:
    cleanup = True
    for region, name in secrets:
        if region == SOURCE:
            observe('cleanup-remove-replica-' + name, 'remove-regions-from-replication', {'SecretId': name, 'RemoveReplicaRegions': [TARGET]}, region)
    for region, name in secrets:
        observe('cleanup-delete-' + region + '-' + name, 'delete-secret', {'SecretId': name, 'ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery': True}, region)
    for region, name in secrets:
        for n in range(12):
            result = observe('cleanup-absence-' + region + '-' + name + '-' + str(n+1), 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': name}, region)
            if result['code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                break
            time.sleep(2)
    if role:
        observe('cleanup-delete-role-policy', 'delete-role-policy', {'RoleName': PREFIX, 'PolicyName': 'owned-probe-only'}, service='iam')
        observe('cleanup-delete-role', 'delete-role', {'RoleName': PREFIX}, service='iam')
        observe('cleanup-role-absence', 'get-role', {'RoleName': PREFIX}, service='iam')
    fixture['finished_ms'] = int(time.time()*1000)
    save()
print(str(FIXTURE), flush=True)
